root_text:
#HMPV 
🩺 Symptoms: Cough, fever, nasal congestion, shortness of breath. Severe cases may lead to bronchitis or pneumonia.
⏳ Incubation: 3-6 days.
🔄 Spread: Cough/sneeze droplets, contact, or contaminated surfaces.

nodes.text:
🛡️ Prevention: Handwashing, avoid touching face, stay home when sick, disinfect surfaces. 
🧪 Testing: NAAT or antigen detection.
💊 Treatment: No vaccine or specific antiviral; supportive care only.
